name: Coming Of Jesus Christ
overview: The coming of Jesus Christ is a future, visible event marked by His glorious return, as described in Scripture. Jesus Himself declares that His coming will be unmistakable and widespread, like lightning shining from east to west (Matthew 24:27), yet the exact day and hour remain known only to the Father (Matthew 24:36). Believers eagerly anticipate this blessed hope and glorious appearing of our Savior (Titus 2:13), when He will come with clouds and all will see Him, including those who pierced Him (Revelation 1:7). At His return, Christ will bring reward according to each person's works, emphasizing both His justice and authority (Revelation 22:12).
